svg.text: Tabs: Project, then one per analysis (Overall Level, Order Tracking, Spectrogram 2D, Spectrum 1D), Workflow and Settings.
Refresh: recompute the open graph with the current settings.
Compute Batch: compute the analysis for a whole folder and keep it in the Result Pool.
Analysis settings: FFT size and window; they apply to graphs you open or refresh next.
View: display format, scale and amplitude mode; changing them redraws without recomputing.
Help: opens this help on the page for the active tab.
